title: 第8章  需要我把衣服脱光吗？
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
两个跟班顿时哄笑起来。
“孙师兄，这老头怕不是活腻歪了。”
“看他那副德行，风吹吹就散了，还敢管闲事？”
孙泽目光突然扫到李寒山腰间的令牌，顿时笑得更放肆了：“原来是个炉鼎啊？我还以为是什么大人物呢。”
他脸色一冷，目露凶光：“一个被人骑的破炉鼎，也敢管我的事？你算什么东西！”
许灵溪这才认出李寒山，又惊又喜：“李爷爷？你怎么在这里——”
话说到一半，她看到孙泽凶神恶煞的样子，又急又怕：“李爷爷快走，这不关你的事......”
李寒山神色不变：“今天我还就管定了！”
孙泽目光一寒：“老东西，你找死！”
他手掐法诀，就要施展术法给李寒山一个教训。
“我是花弄影的炉鼎，你动我一下试试！”
但李寒山的下一句话，让孙泽全身一滞。
花弄影。
这个名字在合欢宗，尤其是外门弟子中，简直就是一座大山。
内门天骄，炼气大圆满，心狠手辣，睚眦必报。上个月有个外门弟子不过是在背后说了她一句闲话，第二天就被打断了两条腿，扔进了妖兽林里自生自灭。
动她的炉鼎？那是嫌命长了！
孙泽下意识地退了一步，但马上又站住了——当着几个跟班的面，他丢不起这个人。
“少拿花师姐吓唬我！”他强撑着道，“你一个炉鼎，不过是她玩腻了就吸干的玩意儿，还真把自己当根葱了？”
李寒山不怒反笑，往前又踏了一步，几乎贴上孙泽的脸。
“那你试试。”

他仰起脸，眯起眼睛，嘴角挂着一丝嘲弄，手指着自己的脸：“来，往这儿打。”
孙泽愣住了。
李寒山继续道：“你打我一拳，我就去找花弄影哭诉，说你欺负她的人。你猜猜，她会怎么对你？”
孙泽的额头沁出了冷汗。
花弄影的狠辣，他可是亲眼见过的，就算李寒山是炉鼎，但那也是花弄影的炉鼎，他还真不敢动李寒山！
李寒山又往前走了一步，孙泽下意识往后退。
“不敢打啊？”冷笑声中，李寒山扬手，就是一巴掌扇在孙泽脸上：“你不打，我打。”
“啪！”
这一巴掌，把孙泽扇懵了，他完全没料到，李寒山区区一个炉鼎，竟然对他这个外门弟子动手！
“你找死！”孙泽怒气冲天，身上灵力涌动。
“孙师兄，别冲动。”
“快，拉住他！”
“孙师兄，你跟他一个将死之人计较什么，他这明显是想拉你下水！”
孙泽的几个跟班吓坏了，赶紧拉着孙泽，生怕他对李寒山出手。
“没想到这老头这么有种！”
“一个炉鼎，竟敢打外门弟子？真嚣张啊！”
“落在花师姐手中，他活不了几天，左右都是死，不如拉个垫背的。”
围观的人纷纷涌来，一个个啧啧称奇。
合欢宗的炉鼎如麦子一般，割了一茬接一茬，但像李寒山这般嚣张的，实属罕见。
“炉鼎就不能嚣张了吗？”

李寒山将众人的议论听在耳中，心中大定，既然花弄影这妖女的虎皮这么好扯，今天他还就嚣张上了。
他指着孙泽，厉声道：“你再敢打她的主意，以后见一次打你一次，你要是敢还手，我就自杀在你面前。我这条老命不值钱，但你嘛，可以赌赌看花师姐会不会放过你。”
“扑哧~”
不少围观弟子被李寒山的话逗笑了，以自杀来威胁人，整个合欢宗，李寒山还是独一份。
偏方治大病。
这招放在这里，效果偏偏好得出奇。
“好好好！”
孙泽气得浑身发抖，全身灵力却是平息了下去：“老家伙，你护得了她一时，护不了她一世，等你被花师姐吸干，到时候，看我怎么折磨这小丫头！”
孙泽甩下一句狠话后，带着几个跟班灰溜溜的跑路了。
不跑不行，打又不能打，留下来只能是自取其辱，再说围观群众越来越多，万一把花弄影那妖女招来怎么办？
见没有好戏看了，其它人陆续散去。
许灵溪看着李寒山，眼眶红红的：“李爷爷，谢谢你，没想到你也被他们抓到这里来了，我还以为这辈子再也见不到村里的人了。”
李寒山叹了口气。
“丫头...”李寒山习惯性地想喊“丫头”，话到嘴边却又顿住了。
丫头这个称呼，他已经给了洛璃，成了她的专属称呼。
“灵溪，你怎么也在这里？”
“李爷爷，我现在是合欢宗的候选弟子，只要在49天内突破炼气，就可以成为外门弟子了......”
集市的一角，许灵溪将发生的事徐徐道来。
她的情况比李寒山好多了，李寒山是炉鼎，许灵溪则是被合欢宗看上，被迫加入了合欢宗，成了候选弟子。
候选弟子比炉鼎的地位高出不少，但她49天内必须突破炼气，否则降为炉鼎，到时候下场不会比其它炉鼎好多少。

李寒山听完后，关切问道：“你有把握么？”
许灵溪神色一黯，俏脸上却是有了几丝羞意：“李爷爷，我听他们说，想要在49天内成功，恐怕只能租个炉鼎，我......我不想那样做，所以一直没太大进展。”
啥？租炉鼎？炉鼎还能租？
李寒山细问之下，明白了过来。在合欢宗，并非每个妖女都如花弄影一般凶残，炉鼎在她那里活不过三天。
许多外门妖女由于资源有限，遇到好一点的炉鼎，都会当成长期血包，讲究细水长流，不会一次性吸尽榨干。
这些妖女中，就有一些会把炉鼎租给买不起炉鼎的人，赚点灵石与人脉。
“你有多少灵石？”
“入门的时候，宗门一次性发了十块，说这就是我们的卖身钱，若突破不了炼气，就当卖身给宗门当炉鼎了。”
“还有卖身钱？”李寒山翻了个白眼，凭啥人家能成候选弟子，拿着卖身钱，而他被抓到黑市拍卖去了，连个机会都不给。
凭他年纪大吗！
他突然想起了孙泽的话，想到一个关键的问题：“你是不是还剩十天了？”
许灵溪神色一黯：“嗯！”
李寒山又问：“那你现在修炼到什么程度了，开脉了吗？”
许灵溪一脸沮丧：“还没有，李爷爷，我是不是太笨了？”
李寒山摇头：“不是你的问题。”
在他看来，确实不是许灵溪的问题，合欢宗给她提供的功法，根本不是正经修炼的，而是需要去找个炉鼎来采补。
许灵溪不去租炉鼎，再修炼一个月，都有可能开不了脉。
“灵溪，带我去你住的地方，我可以帮你。”
李寒山了解了全部情况后，决定帮许灵溪一把。毕竟是来自同一个村的故人，这妹子一家人都不错，更帮助过李寒山。
他在有能力的时候，若是看着许灵溪沦为炉鼎，将来自己都不会原谅自己。

用修仙者的话说，那是会坏道心的。
“嗯！”
许灵溪感激地点了点头，可紧接着，不知想到了什么，脸颊上悄然浮起一抹绯红。所幸天色已暗，不那么显眼。
她带着李寒山一路来到了她的住处，那是一长排房子中的一间，待遇跟花弄影这种内门天骄远远没法比。
这些房间的隔音显然不怎么样。夜色已深，各种淫靡之声从一间间房里传出，不难想象里头正发生着什么。
看来选择租炉鼎的候选弟子不少。
等进到房间时，许灵溪的脸已经红到了脖子根。她连忙将门关上，声音总算小了一些。
“李爷爷，需要我把衣服脱光吗？”
许灵溪偷偷打量了一眼李寒山后，怯怯的问。
content_en:
The two followers suddenly burst into laughter.
"Senior Brother Sun, I'm afraid this old man is tired of living."
"Look at his virtue, it will be gone in the wind, but he still dares to meddle in other people's business?"
Sun Ze's eyes suddenly glanced at the token on Li Hanshan's waist, and he smiled even more wildly: "So it's a furnace? I thought it was some big shot."
His face turned cold and his eyes revealed a fierce look: "How dare you interfere with my business even if you are being ridden by a broken furnace? Who do you think you are!"
Only then did Xu Lingxi recognize Li Hanshan, and was surprised and happy: "Grandpa Li? Why are you here -"
Halfway through her words, she saw Sun Ze's fierce look and was anxious and scared: "Grandpa Li, leave quickly, this is none of your business..."
Li Hanshan's expression remained unchanged: "I will take care of it today!"
Sun Ze's eyes turned cold: "Old man, you are looking for death!"
He pinched the magic formula with his hand and used it to teach Li Hanshan a lesson.
"I am Hua Nongying's cauldron, please touch me and try!"
But Li Hanshan's next words made Sun Ze shudder.
Flowers and shadows.
This name is like a big mountain among the Hehuan Sect, especially among the outer disciples.
The genius of the inner sect, who is perfect in refining his Qi, is ruthless and ruthless, and will surely retaliate. Last month, an outer disciple just gossiped about her behind her back, and the next day his legs were broken and he was thrown into the monster forest to fend for himself.
Touch her cauldron? That’s too long a life!
Sun Ze subconsciously took a step back, but immediately stopped - in front of several followers, he couldn't afford to lose this person.
"Stop scaring me with Senior Sister Hua!" He said with force, "You are just a furnace, just a thing for her to suck dry when she gets tired of playing with it. Do you really think of yourself as a green onion?"
Li Hanshan smiled instead of being angry, and took another step forward, almost touching Sun Ze's face.
"Then try it."
He raised his face, narrowed his eyes, and with a trace of mockery on his lips, he pointed at his face: "Come on, hit here."
Sun Ze was stunned.
Li Hanshan continued: "If you punch me, I will go to Hua Nongying and cry, saying that you bullied her. Guess what she will do to you?"
Cold sweat broke out on Sun Ze's forehead.
He had seen Hua Nongying's ruthlessness with his own eyes. Even if Li Hanshan was the cauldron, it was still Hua Nongying's cauldron. He really didn't dare to touch Li Hanshan!
Li Hanshan took another step forward, and Sun Ze subconsciously stepped back.
"Don't you dare to fight?" With a sneer, Li Hanshan raised his hand and slapped Sun Ze on the face: "If you don't fight, I will."
"Crack!"
This slap stunned Sun Ze. He had no idea that a furnace in Li Hanshan District would actually attack him, an outer disciple!
"You are looking for death!" Sun Ze was furious, and his spiritual power surged.
"Senior Brother Sun, don't be impulsive."
"Quick, hold him!"
"Senior Brother Sun, why are you arguing with a dying man? He is obviously trying to drag you into trouble!"
Several of Sun Ze's followers were frightened and quickly pulled Sun Ze away, fearing that he would take action against Li Hanshan.
"I didn't expect this old man to be so talented!"
"How dare a furnace cauldron attack an outer disciple? How arrogant!"
"If he falls into the hands of Senior Sister Hua, he won't survive for a few days. Everyone on the left and right will die. It's better to have someone to support him."
The onlookers came one after another, all amazed.
The Hehuan Sect's cauldrons are like wheat, harvested one after another, but it is rare to be as arrogant as Li Hanshan.
"Can't the furnace be arrogant?"
Li Hanshan listened to everyone's comments and was convinced that since the witch Hua Nongying's tiger skin was so easy to pull off, he was even more arrogant today.
He pointed at Sun Ze and said sternly: "If you dare to take advantage of her again, I will beat you every time I see her. If you dare to fight back, I will kill myself in front of you. My life is worthless, but you, you can bet to see if Senior Sister Hua will let you go."
"Puch~"
Many onlookers were amused by Li Hanshan's words and threatened to commit suicide.In the entire Hehuan Sect, Li Hanshan is still the only one.
Folk remedies cure serious illnesses.
Putting this move here, the effect is surprisingly good.
"Okay, okay!"
Sun Ze was so angry that he was shaking all over, but his spiritual power calmed down: "Old guy, you can protect her for a while, but you can't protect her for a lifetime. When you are sucked dry by Senior Sister Hua, then watch how I torture this little girl!"
After Sun Ze said a harsh word, he ran away in despair with a few followers.
You can't run away, and you can't fight. You can only humiliate yourself if you stay. Besides, there are more and more onlookers. What if the enchantress Hua Nongying is attracted?
Seeing that there was no good show to watch, the others dispersed one after another.
Xu Lingxi looked at Li Hanshan with red eyes: "Grandpa Li, thank you. I didn't expect you to be caught here by them. I thought I would never see anyone in the village again in this life."
Li Hanshan sighed.
"Girl..." Li Hanshan wanted to call "Girl" out of habit, but stopped when the words came to his lips.
He had already given Luo Li the title "Girl" and it became her exclusive title.
"Lingxi, why are you here?"
"Grandpa Li, I am now a candidate disciple of the Hehuan Sect. As long as I break through the Qi refining within 49 days, I can become an outer disciple..."
In a corner of the market, Xu Lingxi slowly told what happened.
Her situation is much better than that of Li Hanshan, who is Luding, while Xu Lingxi was attracted by the Hehuan Sect and was forced to join the Hehuan Sect and became a candidate disciple.
The status of the candidate disciple is much higher than that of the furnace, but she must break through the refining of Qi within 49 days, otherwise she will be demoted to the furnace, and her end will not be much better than other furnaces.
After listening to this, Li Hanshan asked with concern: "Are you sure?"
Xu Lingxi's expression darkened, but there was a hint of embarrassment on her pretty face: "Grandpa Li, I heard them say that if you want to succeed within 49 days, I'm afraid you can only rent a furnace. I...I don't want to do that, so I haven't made much progress."
What? Rent a furnace? Can the furnace be rented?
After Li Hanshan asked carefully, he understood. In the Hehuan Sect, not every demon girl is as cruel as a flower and a shadow. The furnace cauldron can only survive three days in her place.
Due to limited resources, many outer sect witches will treat a better furnace cauldron as a long-term blood bag. They pay attention to the steady flow of water and will not drain it all at once.
Some of these witches will rent the furnace cauldron to people who cannot afford the furnace cauldron to earn some spiritual stones and connections.
"How many spirit stones do you have?"
"When we started, the sect gave us ten yuan at a time, saying that this was the money for selling our bodies. If we couldn't break through the Qi refining process, we would have to sell ourselves to the sect as a cauldron."
"And the money for selling one's body?" Li Hanshan rolled his eyes, how could he become a candidate disciple and get the money for selling one's body, but he was caught and auctioned on the black market without even a chance.
Is it because of his age?
He suddenly remembered Sun Ze's words and thought of a key question: "Do you have ten days left?"
Xu Lingxi's expression darkened: "Yeah!"
Li Hanshan asked again: "Then how far have you cultivated now? Have you opened your pulse?"
Xu Lingxi looked frustrated: "Not yet, Grandpa Li, am I too stupid?"
Li Hanshan shook his head: "It's not your problem."
In his opinion, it was really not Xu Lingxi's problem. The exercises provided by the Hehuan Sect were not serious cultivation at all, but she needed to find a furnace to collect them.
If Xu Lingxi didn't rent the cauldron, he might not be able to open his pulse if he practiced for another month.
"Lingxi, take me to where you live, I can help you."
After Li Hanshan learned the whole situation, he decided to help Xu Lingxi. After all, they are old friends from the same village. This girl has a good family and has even helped Li Hanshan.
When he was capable, if he saw Xu Lingxi reduced to a furnace, he would never forgive himself in the future.
In the words of immortal cultivators, that will damage the Taoist mind.
"Yeah!"
XuLingxi nodded gratefully, but then, he didn't know what he thought of, and a blush quietly appeared on his cheeks. Fortunately, it was dark and not so noticeable.
She took Li Hanshan all the way to her residence, which was one of the long rows of houses. The treatment was far incomparable to that of a talented person like Hua Nongying.
The soundproofing of these rooms is obviously not very good. It was already dark, and all kinds of obscene sounds were coming from one room after another. It was not difficult to imagine what was going on inside.
It seems that there are many candidate disciples who choose to rent the furnace.
By the time they entered the room, Xu Lingxi's face was already red to the root of her neck. She quickly closed the door and her voice finally became quieter.
"Grandpa Li, do you need me to take off all my clothes?"
Xu Lingxi looked at Li Hanshan secretly and asked timidly.
